title: FSCD 2027
notes: Co-located with CADE-31. FSCD paper submission dates are not posted on the joint site.

The FSCD 2027 CFP lists a Best Paper Award by Junior Researchers. Eligibility: at least one author must be a student or have received their PhD less than three years before the meeting; coauthors must declare that junior researcher(s) made at least 50% of the contribution. Source: https://easychair.org/cfp/FSCD2027
Joint FSCD/CADE workshop and tutorial proposal call: https://fscd-cade.science.ru.nl/calls/workshops-and-tutorials
